list:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <TextField source="id"/>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>
create:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <ArrayInput source="entities">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput multiline sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Admin">
   <TextInput multiline source="list" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
   <TextInput multiline source="create" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
   <TextInput multiline source="edit" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Components">
   <ArrayInput source="components" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput source="name"/>
     <RadioButtonGroupInput source="findOne" choices={[{id: true, name: 'One'}, {id: false, name: 'Many'}]}/>
     <TextInput multiline source="findOptions" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
     <TextInput multiline source="element" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
     <TextInput source="title" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>
